name: One Arm Medicine Ball Slam
how_to:
- Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the medicine ball in one hand overhead.
- Ensure your torso remains upright, and avoid leaning back excessively.
- Slam the medicine ball down firmly onto the ground in front of you.
- Catch the rebound and return to the starting position.
- Perform the exercise with both arms to ensure balanced muscle development.
